tips: Pokémon Center: no schedule, but about a third of drops land on Wednesdays around midday ET (often with a queue).
Target: restocks mostly Friday mornings around 8 AM local; Monday and Wednesday are backups.
Walmart: shelves Tue–Fri 7–10 AM; online MSRP drops are reported Wednesday evenings.
Best Buy: no fixed pattern online, the bot reads its buy button about every half hour.
Release day: big-store pages often flip from Coming Soon to Add to Cart at midnight–6 AM ET.
Sell fast on new releases: preorder prices usually slide into launch (Delta Reign ETB −15% and its Pokémon Center ETB −21% in the month before release).

tips: Walmart: the card vendor (usually MJ Holding) stocks Tue–Fri, 7–10 AM; Thursday mornings have the best reported hit rate.

Target.com: about 84% of tracked restocks landed Friday 3–6 AM ET. In stores, Friday afternoon is the usual fill; each store has its own vendor route (reported as Excell Marketing, secondhand), so ask the card-aisle team which day yours comes.
Target app: set your store on the exact product page. "Ready within 2 hours" pickup means it is there, and a pickup order holds it before you drive.
Both: limits are per store (often 1–2 per guest). Check the shelf tag, not just the app; counts can lag.
Release days: new sets hit shelves on the release date, often before the vendor's usual day.
